realReviews.author: Raf Fitzpatrick
realReviews.text:
I had an exceptional experience with Newcastle Carpentry recently when they built our new deck. From the initial consultation to the project's completion, Caleb and Liam demonstrated professionalism, expertise, and an unwavering commitment to delivering top-notch craftsmanship.

Their communication was clear and responsive, addressing all my questions about the deck construction. The carpenters exhibited precision and skill, ensuring the deck met high standards. Punctual and efficient, they maintained a tidy work environment throughout the process (What a bonus!).

The finished deck not only surpassed my expectations but also reflected their dedication to quality work. I highly recommend Newcastle Carpentry for deck projects and other carpentry needs, as their reliability and commitment to customer satisfaction truly set them apart.

I'll definitely turn to them for future projects and I confidently recommend them and their service to anyone needing work done to their house.

realReviews.author: Nicky Morriss
realReviews.text: I am very happy with the stunning deck that Newcastle Carpentry built for me. They were professional, fast, and tidy. Caleb is a master carpenter who delivered a flawless result. He did an excellent job and I highly recommend them.

realReviews.author: Alexandra Evans
realReviews.text: We hired Newcastle Carpentry for some odd jobs outside around our home - putting on new awnings, window trims & replacing rotted weatherboards and had an excellent experience. Not only was the work completed to a high quality, but the communication along the way was prompt and easy (after dealing with a lot of tradies renovating our entire home, this was very appreciated as it’s not always the case!). The boys gave honest opinions about what to do properly and where we could take some short cuts and cut costs, while still getting an excellent finish. They also engaged further trades (eg painters) on our behalf for next steps. They tidied after themselves and were a pleasure to have around. I would highly recommend them for any carpentry work you need done, and would have them back to do anything else around our place that needed doing.
